best_for: Small drop-in yoga upstairs at Hotel Tugu, Batu Bolong; walk-ins welcome
not_for: Timetabled classes only; check the weekly schedule before turning up

context_not_for_copy.spend: Walk-in class 150K · 10-day pass 1,350K · Private class 750K

name: HOME by Chef Wayan
where: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No. 92, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Modern Balinese cooking from Chef Wayan Kresna Yasa, on Jl. Pantai Pererenan near the beach, reworking family and island recipes with contemporary technique. The menu marks vegan dishes across every course, alongside sate, seafood and traditional mains.
best_for: A considered Balinese dinner; a table mixing meat, seafood and vegan diners
not_for: The restaurant asks you to book a table in advance

context_not_for_copy.spend: Mains 95-180K · Sate 25-85K per stick · Five-course set 395K · Excl. 10% tax and 5% service

name: Indigo
where: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.7A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Indigo has been serving Japanese food in Berawa since 2017, under Kyoto-trained chef Morita Shigehiko — a sushi and sashimi selection alongside yakimono cooked over charcoal. The room is small and deliberately plain: shoji-style doors, timeworn teak, indigo denim cushions.
best_for: Japanese sushi and charcoal-grilled yakimono in a small, quiet Berawa room.
not_for: An afternoon meal — closed 15:00-18:00 between services, and all day Sunday.

name: ISLA by Earth Island
why_its_here: The all-day cafe attached to Earth Island's surf shop at Jl. Subak Canggu No.77, on the Canggu shortcut. Its own menu runs from breakfast and coffee through seafood snacks, grilled mains and cocktails. The site also describes it as a space for events, music, art and film.
best_for: Post-surf breakfast and seafood snacks at the Earth Island surf shop.
not_for: Closes 7pm Sun-Thu; only Fri and Sat run to 9pm.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Mains 90-250K - Snacks 50-140K - Coffee 30-40K - plus 10% tax and 5% service

name: Jet Black Ginger Canggu
why_its_here: A Canggu hair salon specialising in cut and colour for all hair types, with online appointment booking.
best_for: Travellers who want a proper cut or colour by stylists used to international hair.

name: Ju Bali
where: 80361, Jl. Bumbak Dauh No.8, Kerobokan, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Casual restaurant in Umalas with a jacuzzi club. International comfort food with a Balinese turn: pasta, burgers and wood-fired pizza. Vegetarian and vegan plates include tandoori cauliflower and mushroom tagliatelle. 200 seats, a kids menu and parking for cars and scooters.
best_for: Families and groups who need space and parking
not_for: A quiet dinner for two - it seats 200 as a family venue

name: Jungle Padel Canggu
why_its_here: Canggu padel courts open early until late, offering court hire and social games of the fast-growing racket sport.
best_for: Groups and couples who want a fun, active session on court rather than a gym.

name: Jungle Padel Canggu Shortcut
why_its_here: A dedicated padel racket-sport club on the Canggu shortcut with panoramic glass-walled courts set in tropical greenery. Courts are booked by the hour through the Jungle Padel app, with racket hire, coaching, a pro shop, changing rooms and an on-site café.
best_for: active travellers who want a padel game between beach sessions; groups of four booking a court together; players needing rental rackets or a lesson
not_for: total downtime or a spa-style wellness stop; anyone without a pre-booked court at peak times

context_not_for_copy.spend: $$ · court ~350–450K/hr (racket hire ~50K)

name: Kecambah Restaurant at Lalasa Villas
where: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Pantai Berawa No.12 Canggu Kuta, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Kecambah is the street-front restaurant of Lalasa Villas on Pantai Berawa — a casual all-day room serving breakfast through late, with an Indonesian emphasis alongside Western dishes, plus a Balinese rijsttafel evening and a booked-ahead afternoon tea.
best_for: An all-day, street-front breakfast-to-late menu at Lalasa Villas in Berawa.
not_for: Same-day afternoon tea — the villa asks for a day's notice on that menu.

name: Kopiten
where: Jl. Raya Tumbakbayuh - Pererenan, Tumbak Bayuh, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: A small casual coffee shop in the Tumbakbayuh-Pererenan part of Canggu, open 07:30-20:00, serving espresso drinks alongside a short toast-based menu.
best_for: Remote workers and long-stay visitors who want a quiet, low-key coffee stop away from the busier Canggu cafes.

name: La Brisa Bali
why_its_here: A rustic, sustainability-minded beach club on the foreshore of Echo Beach, hand-built from reclaimed wood salvaged from old Indonesian fishing boats, with a saltwater pool, a raw/oyster bar and wood-fired Mediterranean food. Best known for its driftwood aesthetic and long, open sunset views over the surf break.
best_for: Sunset drinks and a laid-back beach day with friends; a relaxed shared meal by the water
not_for: Daybeds and cabanas carry a 1M-3.5M++ minimum spend after 4pm.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Pizzas 150-215K · Large plates 170-285K · Cocktails 150K · plus 8% service, 10% tax

name: LOOP cafe
where: Jl. Dalem Lingsir No.12, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: High-protein breakfast cafe in Pererenan. The menu is built on eggs, salmon, chicken, cottage cheese, Greek yoghurt, oats and sourdough. Six protein shakes for after training. Specialty coffee, smoothie bowls, wraps and vegan options.
best_for: Breakfast before the gym or after a surf
not_for: Dinner - the kitchen closes at 18:00

name: LowCal, Cheatery and Bar
where: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, No.94, Canggu, Bali 80361
why_its_here: LowCal builds its menu around low-calorie, paleolithic and ketogenic options. The venue trains and employs deaf team members across kitchen, bar and service roles. Dinner choices include chicken, pork, fish and vegetarian dishes with low-carb sides.
best_for: Health-led dining that includes low-carb choices and an inclusive service team.
not_for: Diners seeking a traditional Balinese warung meal.

name: Lulu Bistrot
why_its_here: A French bistro on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong serving classic bistro cooking made with local, seasonal ingredients in a relaxed, grand-cafe-inspired room and bar. It opens in the evenings with an early happy hour.
best_for: Couples and small groups wanting an unhurried French dinner and drinks in the evening.
not_for: Not a quick warung stop or a budget meal.

name: Luma
why_its_here: An intimate, 30-seat open-air spot on Batu Bolong doing rustic Mediterranean small plates — Spanish- and Italian-style grazing — from chefs Cameron Emirali (10 Greek Street, London) and Kieran Morland (Merah Putih, Sangsaka). Draught beer, cocktails on tap and vinyl DJs on weekends.
best_for: Golden-hour drinks and small plates; date night; a lively pre-dinner stop that becomes the evening.

name: Lyma Beach
where: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pantai Lima / Seseh-Cemagi route
why_its_here: A beachfront bar and restaurant on Pantai Lima where the river meets the ocean, known for sunset views, cocktails and live entertainment through the week.
best_for: Sunset drinks by the beach, group get-togethers, and a relaxed beachfront meal with live music.
not_for: A quiet work session or an intimate fine-dining evening.

name: Manhattan Cocktail Hookah Kitchen
where: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong No.58, Canggu, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Manhattan is a cocktail bar with shisha service and a kitchen on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong. It publishes no website — only a link page — and its menu is not readable online, so what we can confirm is the format, the address and that booking runs through WhatsApp.
best_for: Cocktails and shisha with a kitchen attached, on Batu Bolong.
not_for: A smoke-free room — hookah is part of the format, by the venue's own name.

name: Mason
why_its_here: A moody, minimalist grill on Batu Bolong (trading as MASONRY.) built around wood-fired, Mediterranean-leaning cooking, in-house charcuterie and a serious wine and cocktail list. It's one of Canggu's go-to rooms for a proper sit-down dinner.
best_for: Wood-fired grill and charcuterie with a serious wine list, from midday to late.
not_for: The Chop House room — it runs dinner only, Tuesday to Saturday.

name: MiA - Asian Modern-Inspired Restaurant & Bar
where: Jl. Raya Semat, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: MiA is a modern Asian restaurant and bar off Jl. Raya Semat, built around a sharing format — sushi rolls, raw plates, curries, wok and grill — running from evening into the early hours at weekends.
best_for: Modern Asian sharing plates and sushi, dinner into late, off Jl. Raya Semat.
not_for: A quiet dinner — it runs to midnight, and to 1am at weekends.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Sharing plates 135-265K · Edamame 65K · Wagyu ribeye 1,095K

name: MIEL Specialty Coffee Canggu
why_its_here: A serious specialty-coffee cafe on Batu Bolong with a dedicated brew bar (V60, pour-over, cold brew) built on quality beans, set in a bright, plant-filled, high-ceilinged space. Spacious tables, quiet room and fast wifi make it a genuine work spot as much as a coffee stop.
best_for: Coffee-focused solo travellers and remote workers who want a proper filter coffee and a calm table to sit and work for a few hours; also an easy morning brunch.
not_for: Best in the daytime rather than as an evening or late-night hangout.

name: Milk & Madu Berawa
why_its_here: The Berawa flagship of Milk & Madu, a long-running all-day Canggu cafe brand doing hearty brunch, lava-stone pizzas and family-friendly dinners. A dependable, crowd-pleasing all-rounder.
best_for: Families and groups; a big post-surf brunch; an easy all-day meal that suits fussy and hungry tables alike.
not_for: Couples seeking an intimate, quiet dining atmosphere.

name: Milu by Nook
why_its_here: A long-standing Berawa restaurant set in a garden overlooking a small rice paddy on Jl. Pantai Berawa, serving Balinese-Western dishes and coffee from morning until night.
best_for: A calm garden brunch or dinner over a Berawa rice paddy.
not_for: A budget breakfast — mains run 100-250K.

name: Mission Flow Studio
why_its_here: Mission Flow Studio is a yoga and conscious-movement studio in Pererenan, set in a light-filled space with panoramic windows minutes from the sea, offering Vinyasa flow, Yin and Restorative classes with a rotating roster of experienced teachers.
best_for: Travellers and locals wanting varied yoga classes (strong Vinyasa to gentle Yin/Restorative) in a serene Pererenan studio; drop-ins and regular practitioners.

name: Moana Fish Eatery
why_its_here: A Tahitian-Polynesian fish eatery on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong serving fresh seafood — poke bowls, sashimi, carpaccio, tartare and BBQ fish — in a laid-back setting, open from morning until late.
best_for: Tahitian-Polynesian raw fish and poke, casual, from morning to late.
not_for: A red-meat dinner — the kitchen is built around fish.

name: Mosto Berawa
why_its_here: An intimate neo-bistro and natural wine bar in the heart of Berawa, billed as Indonesia's first natural wine bar, with a compact room of around 60 covers and a curated list of 70+ natural-wine labels from small producers alongside ingredient-focused food. An evenings-only spot for food and wine lovers.
best_for: A date or intimate dinner centred on natural wine; a small group of wine lovers
not_for: Large groups or anyone after a big beachfront party scene

name: Motion Cafe
why_its_here: A fitness-focused cafe in the Berawa area from Motion Fitness Foods, built around healthy, customizable meals, meal prep and macro-friendly plates.
best_for: Gym-goers and fitness-minded travellers wanting clean, protein-forward food and healthy breakfasts.
not_for: Diners looking for a rich, indulgent or traditional dining experience.

name: Murmur Restaurant Lounge
where: Jl. Anggrek No.2, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Murmur is a two-storey all-day restaurant and lounge on Jl. Anggrek with over a hundred seats, a VIP room for eleven, and tables looking over the rice fields at sunset. Breakfast runs to 4pm, then the kitchen switches to the dinner menu and the room stays open to 2am.
best_for: A two-floor all-day room over the rice fields — breakfast to 4pm, then dinner.
not_for: Breakfast after 4pm — the kitchen switches to the dinner menu then.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Freelancer's lunch: bowl + drink 299K (4-7pm)

name: Nail Lesss Canggu
why_its_here: Nail Lesss is a nail salon on Jalan Pantai Pererenan offering manicures, gel and acrylic extensions and classic eyelash extensions, known for a clean space and detailed, unhurried work.
best_for: Travellers wanting careful gel/acrylic manicures or lash extensions in Pererenan by appointment.

name: Neighbourhood Food Berawa
why_its_here: A neighbourhood cafe and coffee shop in the heart of Berawa on Jl. Pantai Berawa, serving slow breakfasts, laid-back snacks and simple wholesome dishes made from local produce; daytime hours.
best_for: A relaxed brunch, coffee and healthy casual daytime eating.
not_for: Not an evening dinner venue - the Berawa branch closes at 6pm.

name: Neighbourhood Food Seseh
why_its_here: A local eatery and coffee shop set among the tranquil Seseh fields, serving slow breakfasts, laid-back afternoon snacks and weekend dinners with fresh, simple dishes from local produce.
best_for: A relaxed breakfast or brunch, an easy weekend dinner, and calm coffee stops away from the crowds.
not_for: A high-energy party or beach-club atmosphere.

name: Nirvana Strength Tibubeneng
why_its_here: Wellness club on Jl. Pantai Berawa with more than 100 classes a week: strength, yoga, pilates, mobility, breathwork and sound. Recovery runs to ice baths, saunas, steam rooms, hot tubs and pools. A day pass covers 20+ classes and the recovery spa.
best_for: A day pass that covers training and recovery

name: NÜDE Berawa
why_its_here: A popular healthy cafe at a busy Berawa junction on Jl. Pantai Berawa, serving wholesome bowls, salads, wraps, smoothies and coffee from breakfast to evening; part of a small Bali group.
best_for: A healthy brunch or casual all-day meal - good for digital nomads and families.
not_for: A quiet, tucked-away table — it sits on a busy Berawa junction.

name: Obsidian Gym Bali
why_its_here: A premium, design-led Canggu gym with high-end equipment and recovery facilities, open 6am–10pm daily.
best_for: Serious lifters who want top-tier kit and don't mind a premium day pass (449k).

name: Only Nails Pererenan
why_its_here: Only Nails is a nail salon on Jl. Raya Tiyingtutul in Pererenan specialising in the Russian manicure technique and long-wear gel systems, with an option for 4-hands manicure-and-pedicure service in a calm, retreat-like space.
best_for: Travellers wanting a precise Russian manicure or long-lasting gel work, including quick 4-hands mani-pedi sessions, in Pererenan.

name: Paed Thai — Canggu
where: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Thai restaurant on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, part of the Wonderspace group. Tom yum goong, pad thai, green curry and mango sticky rice. Indoor and outdoor seating facing rice fields.
best_for: Thai food at the end of a Canggu day

name: Pizza Fabbrica
why_its_here: A Neapolitan pizzeria on Jl. Batu Mejan turning out wood-fired, thin and light pizzas plus fresh pasta in an industrial-chic space, with a second branch in Umalas.
best_for: A casual pizza dinner with friends or family, and groups sharing.

name: Poule de Luxe Bali
why_its_here: French patisserie and bakery on Jl. Batu Belig serving authentic pastries; best known for its cream puffs, plus macarons, tarts and viennoiserie. Take-away/eat-in, and supplies desserts to villas, parties and restaurants.
best_for: a pastry or coffee stop and sweet take-away; celebration/letter cakes and gifts; grab-and-go breakfast pastries
not_for: anyone wanting a full sit-down meal or savoury dinner

context_not_for_copy.spend: $ · pastries ~25–45K each

name: Revolver Canggu
why_its_here: The Canggu outpost of Revolver, a homegrown Bali coffee brand (est. 2012) that roasts its own beans. An all-day cafe on Jl. Nelayan doing serious espresso, full brunch and heavier evening plates, turning bar-ish after dark.
best_for: Coffee-led brunch after surf; a laptop-friendly morning; an easy all-day sit-down.
not_for: A calm evening meal -- it turns bar-ish after dark.

name: Rise and Shine Cafe
why_its_here: A long-running, colourful all-day breakfast and lunch cafe on Jl. Padang Linjong in Canggu (open since 2017) serving fresh, health-conscious comfort food, coffee and juices in an open-air, al-fresco setting.
best_for: A bright, casual morning-after-the-beach breakfast or brunch, good for solo travellers, couples and small groups wanting healthy plates.
not_for: A daytime breakfast-and-lunch spot rather than an evening dinner or drinks venue.

name: Rite Bali
why_its_here: A wellness club on Jl. Pantai Pererenan combining a gym, yoga classes and a recovery zone with a sauna, a cold plunge held at 7-9°C, a jacuzzi and a steam room. Recovery and gym access are bundled on a day pass (500k).
best_for: Active travellers and athletes who want training, yoga and contrast recovery in one Pererenan spot.
not_for: Anyone looking for a traditional pampering spa rather than an active recovery and fitness space.

name: RITE Bali Recovery
why_its_here: The recovery-and-spa side of RITE Bali in Pererenan — sauna, ice bath and bodywork bundled with gym access on a day pass (500k).
best_for: Fitness travellers who want training plus contrast recovery in one Pererenan spot.

name: RITE Bali Yoga
why_its_here: The yoga strand of RITE Bali in Pererenan, offering classes alongside the club's gym and recovery facilities.
best_for: Members and visitors who want yoga bundled with training and recovery.

name: Riviera Bistro Berawa
why_its_here: A modern Mediterranean bistro and wine bar in Berawa (open since 2020) with whitewashed arches, an extensive wine list and a daily Aperitivo hour; open from late morning until late, with a Saturday DJ night.
best_for: Date night, aperitivo and dinner with drinks, and lively evenings.
not_for: Not a quiet or budget spot.

name: Riviera Cafe Cemagi
why_its_here: A tranquil garden cafe in quiet Cemagi from the Riviera Group, leaning Mediterranean-Italian, with cozy interiors, greenery and live acoustic music on Saturday evenings.
best_for: A calm, unhurried breakfast, lunch or relaxed evening meal away from the Canggu crowds; couples wanting a low-key setting.
not_for: Beachfront views or a high-energy party scene.

name: Riviera Trattoria Pererenan
why_its_here: The Riviera Group's Pererenan trattoria for authentic Italian: hand-rolled pastas, Neapolitan pizzas and an extensive wine and cocktail list in a cozy, lively room.
best_for: Date night, group dinners over shared Italian plates and wine, and a lively casual evening.
not_for: A quiet daytime work cafe or beachfront setting.

name: Rize Cafe
why_its_here: A Pererenan cafe serving contemporary Indian home cooking alongside brunch classics, craft cocktails and house chai, with spices ground daily and dishes rooted in family recipes.
best_for: Spice lovers wanting Indian food, a distinctive brunch, or cocktails and chai in a relaxed setting; small groups sharing dishes.
not_for: Diners after a beach-club or sunset-view scene.

name: Ruko Cafe
why_its_here: An Australian-style neighbourhood cafe about 300m from Berawa beach, serving locally sourced healthy food and its own Indonesian coffee blend, with 40-50% local organic produce. A reliable daily breakfast and brunch stop.
best_for: Post-beach breakfast, brunch and coffee for solo travellers, couples and families who want fresh, organic-leaning food near Berawa.
not_for: A daytime cafe rather than an evening or dinner destination.

name: Sa'Mesa Canggu | Experience Dining
where: Jalan Tanah Barak No.1e, Canggu, Bali 80351
why_its_here: An Italian communal-dining restaurant in Canggu, open since early 2021 and built around a single long table. There is no menu: guests are served a set procession of roughly 14-18 shared dishes that changes daily, with plates such as tuna crudo, grilled octopus and house fettuccine placed down the middle of the table.
best_for: Groups and solo travellers up for a set-menu Italian dinner where you share one table with strangers rather than order for yourself.

name: Sama Sama Prime
where: Jl. Raya Semat No.99, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80360
why_its_here: Sama Sama Prime is a steakhouse and sushi bar on Jl. Raya Semat, part of the Sama Sama group. Its own site describes it two ways — a steakhouse sushi bar on the homepage, a modern premium Japanese restaurant on the about page — and we have left that unreconciled rather than pick one.
best_for: Steak and sushi under one roof, on Jl. Raya Semat in Canggu.

name: Samadi Bali
why_its_here: A yoga and wellness hub on Jl. Padang Linjong in Canggu's Batu Bolong area, with an organic vegetarian cafe certified by the Slow Food movement, serving superfood bowls and traditional Indian dishes.
best_for: Yoga-goers and wellness travellers wanting a calm, plant-based meal before or after a class.
not_for: Anyone after meat dishes, alcohol or a high-energy social scene.

name: Sa'Mesa Canggu
where: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.1e, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: A one-of-a-kind communal Italian dinner: everyone shares one long table for a multi-course, family-style set menu inspired by an Italian grandmother's table. Dinner only, one seating, book ahead — it's an event as much as a meal.
best_for: A communal Italian set-menu dinner at one long shared table, one seating a night.
not_for: Walking in — booking only, dinner only, one 7:30pm seating.

context_not_for_copy.spend: 599k++ per guest

name: Santanera
why_its_here: A stylish Latin American dining room and rooftop bar on Jl. Tanah Barak, blending Latin flavours with European technique and local ingredients across a sharing-focused menu. Contemporary artwork, a big seated room and a late-night bar make it a full evening out.
best_for: Date night; group dinners built around shared plates; a special evening with cocktails on the rooftop.

name: Satu-Satu Coffee Company
why_its_here: A family-run specialty coffee company in Berawa built on the Sudana family's Balinese single-origin beans, roasted in-house, with a bright, eco-minded white space and a simple all-day menu of bowls, sandwiches and smoothies for the post-surf crowd.
best_for: Coffee lovers and post-surf travellers wanting well-pulled espresso built on Indonesian single origins plus a healthy breakfast or lunch bowl.
not_for: A daytime coffee-and-brunch spot rather than an evening venue.

name: Saya Club
why_its_here: Gym and coworking space in Berawa, open around the clock. Personal training and classes in pilates, reformer, boxing and yoga. Ice bath, sauna, pool and a cafe-bar on site.
best_for: Training at any hour, including the middle of the night

name: Secana Rooftop
where: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Tibubeneng, Berawa, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Secana Rooftop sits on top of the Secana Beachtown resort in Berawa — a pool bar and restaurant open from morning to 11pm, with daybeds by day, a menu moving between Mediterranean and comfort cooking, and DJ sunset sessions on Fridays and Sundays.
best_for: A rooftop pool bar in Berawa — daybeds by day, DJ sunsets Friday and Sunday.
not_for: A cheap drop-in — pool daybeds carry a 350K++ per-person minimum spend.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Pool daybed minimum spend 350K+++ per person

name: Secret Spot
where: Jl. Tanah Barak No. 7, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A fully plant-based cafe serving vegan breakfast through dinner, with vegan croissants, bowls, curries and ramen, plus coffee roasted weekly on the island. Extras like Monday pasta nights with live jazz and a chicory coffee alternative round out the character.
best_for: vegan breakfast and brunch; plant-based croissants and pastries; island-roasted coffee; relaxed all-day dining
not_for: diners set on meat or seafood dishes; anyone wanting a fast grab-and-go stop

name: Seseh General Store
why_its_here: An Aussie-owned corner cafe bringing Melbourne coffee culture to coastal Cemagi/Seseh, doing well-made breads, sandwiches and salads a short step from the beach, with a community-hub feel.
best_for: A morning coffee and pastry, a casual sandwich-and-salad lunch, and a laid-back neighbourhood cafe stop after the beach.
not_for: A sit-down dinner or a formal evening out.

name: Shelter Restaurant
why_its_here: A wood-fired Middle Eastern and Mediterranean restaurant in Pererenan built inside a Balinese joglo with open, plant-filled architecture, a UK chef and a rotating calendar of BBQs and vinyl DJ nights. Reservations recommended.
best_for: Date night, group dinners and special occasions with an atmospheric, reservation-led setting.
not_for: A walk-in quick lunch or a solo laptop session.

name: Shichirin Japanese Restaurant — Canggu
where: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Pantai Berawa no.88 Canggu Kuta, Utara, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Japanese grill restaurant in Berawa, part of the Wonderspace group. Teppanyaki, gyukatsu and izakaya plates, with sushi and sashimi. Black cod in saikyo miso and breaded Santuri wagyu are signatures.
best_for: A grill dinner with a group

name: Shosan Holistic Spa
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Canggu. The published list covers Head Massage and Traditional Massage. Shosan Signature Massage is 1100K IDR for 90 minutes. Booking runs through Fresha.
best_for: Head massage booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 1100K IDR.

context_not_for_copy.spend: $$$ · Shosan Signature Massage 90 min 1100K

name: SIA - Grill & Seafood Bar
where: Jl. Subak Canggu, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: SIA is a casual seafood and grill bar on the Canggu Shortcut, working fresh fish with Balinese ingredients and Asian influences, with a cocktail programme alongside. Open from midday to 11pm daily.
best_for: Fresh seafood and grill with a cocktail bar, on the Canggu Shortcut.
not_for: Breakfast — the kitchen opens at midday.

name: SKOOL Kitchen
why_its_here: An open-flame kitchen on Jl. Pura Dalem in Canggu, cooking meats and seafood over wood and charcoal — a tasting menu alongside à la carte plates and cuts priced by weight. Dinner only, from 5pm. It shares its address with The Lawn Canggu; both are Project Black venues.
best_for: A special-occasion or date-night dinner with a beachside setting and drinks.
not_for: Daytime — it opens at 5pm daily.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Tasting menu 895K per person · à la carte 100-860K · plus 10% tax, 7% service

name: SMOKE – GRILL MASTER & BARBEQUE BALI
where: Echo Beach, Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan Indonesia No.69, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: SMOKE is an open-fire barbecue restaurant at Echo Beach, seating guests outdoors, in a tent or indoors, with a private backyard barn and a chef's table for groups of ten or more booked 48 hours ahead.
best_for: Open-fire barbecue at Echo Beach — tent, indoor or garden seating.
not_for: Booking the garden or deck — reservations cover tent and indoor only.

name: Spring Spa Canggu
why_its_here: A dependable branch of the island-wide Spring Spa chain on the Batu Bolong strip, doing brisk, well-priced manicures, waxing, massage and facials in a bright, clean salon a short walk from Canggu's cafés.
best_for: Visitors who want a reliable walk-in mani-pedi or a quick massage between beach and brunch, without committing to a hotel spa.

name: Surya Fitness Gym
why_its_here: Gym and fight club in Pererenan. Equipment from Life Fitness, Hammer Strength and TechnoGym: racks, barbells, bumpers, kettlebells, benches and conditioning machines. The fight club runs boxing, Muay Thai, pad work and sparring. A rooftop for stretching, a cafe and billiards sit on site. Memberships include air conditioning, water, towels, showers and lockers.
best_for: Lifting and striking under one roof

name: Sushimi Bali
where: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.101C, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: A sushi-train restaurant on Jl. Pantai Berawa serving classic and creative sushi and maki plus an izakaya-style a la carte range. The menu extends to poke bowls, donburi, sushi burritos and sushi donuts, with gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options.
best_for: casual sushi with friends; interactive sushi-train dining; solo diners; mixed dietary groups
not_for: a formal or high-end omakase occasion; a quiet intimate dinner; anyone wanting a sea view

name: Swarna Spa and Wellness
why_its_here: A complete spa and wellness destination in Pererenan offering authentic Balinese and hot stone massage, facials and a signature thermal ritual combining hot plunge, cold immersion and infrared sauna.
best_for: Travellers wanting a full pampering session of massage, facial and thermal/contrast therapy in one calm venue.

name: The Avocado Factory
where: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Billed as South East Asia's first avocado bar, this Berawa-area cafe builds an entire menu around avocado, from truffle eggs benedict to avo pancakes and avocado basque cheesecake, with an eco-conscious build.
best_for: Avocado and brunch lovers; a novelty-led daytime spot that also runs late with burgers into the evening.
not_for: Anyone who dislikes avocado or wants a strictly traditional local menu.

name: The Canggu Studio
why_its_here: A boutique Canggu studio for reformer Pilates, small-group training and mat yoga, on a tidy Mon-Sat timetable (drop-in 170k).
best_for: Those who prefer low-impact reformer Pilates and intimate, well-taught classes over a big gym.

name: The Canggu Studio Yoga
why_its_here: The yoga-and-mat side of The Canggu Studio, offering small-group classes on a clean Mon–Sat timetable (drop-in 170k).
best_for: Those who like intimate, well-taught classes over big drop-in halls.

name: The Flow Bali
where: Jl. Munduk Kedungu Br. Pengembungan No.42, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: The Flow Bali is a char-grill restaurant in Pererenan working modern plates with Mediterranean and Asian influences, from croquettas and carpaccio up to prime cuts on the wood fire.
best_for: Char-grilled Mediterranean-Asian plates and prime cuts in Pererenan.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Mains 110-390K · Pasta 90-190K · Tomahawk 1,700K

name: The Lawn Canggu Beach Club
why_its_here: A lifestyle beach club set directly on the black sand of Batu Bolong Beach, with an ocean-facing infinity pool, daybeds and a bar-restaurant known for sunset sessions and DJs over the Indian Ocean. A long-running Canggu spot for daytime lounging that shifts into golden-hour drinks.
best_for: Sunset cocktails from a daybed; an easy day between surf sessions on Batu Bolong
not_for: A full beach club rather than a quick, cheap breakfast stop.

name: The Loft
where: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No. 50A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A Bondi-inspired all-day brunch cafe on Batu Bolong with specialty coffee and a large plant-based selection. It leans to healthy breakfast staples, bowls and toasts in a relaxed Canggu setting.
best_for: a slow brunch after the beach; specialty coffee and a laptop; plant-based and healthy breakfast eaters
not_for: anyone seeking a quiet non-touristy local spot or a traditional balinese meal

name: The Shady Shack
why_its_here: A breezy all-day vegetarian and vegan cafe overlooking the Berawa rice fields, from the team behind Betelnut. Big wholefood menu — all-day breakfast, smoothies, salads, share plates and vegan desserts — in a leafy, open setting.
best_for: A healthy post-surf brunch; plant-based eaters; a relaxed early dinner with a rice-field view.
not_for: Diners set on meat or seafood -- the menu is entirely vegetarian and vegan.

name: HairShop Canggu
where: Tegal Gundul Square, Jl. Pantai Berawa No.52 Unit 10, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A long-running Bali hair-salon brand's Canggu outpost, known for reliable cuts, colour and blow-outs by English-speaking stylists in a relaxed, air-conditioned space.
best_for: Visitors who want a trustworthy haircut or colour on the road, with easy WhatsApp booking.

name: The Slow
why_its_here: The restaurant, bar and gallery inside The Slow, a design-led boutique hotel on Batu Bolong. The internationally-inspired kitchen runs all day and the room doubles as an art and events space, so it works as both a stylish breakfast stop and an evening destination.
best_for: A design-led brunch or dinner inside The Slow hotel on Batu Bolong.
not_for: A standalone street venue — it sits inside The Slow hotel.

name: Therapy Canggu
why_its_here: The Batu Bolong flagship of the Therapy group, blending massage, facials and beauty in a calm, well-run space (9am–8pm).
best_for: Anyone wanting spa and beauty together near the Batu Bolong strip.

name: Therapy Day Spa Pererenan
why_its_here: A day spa on Jl. Pantai Pererenan built around plant-derived, toxin-free and cruelty-free rituals, offering massages, facials, body scrubs and scalp treatments in a calm sanctuary setting.
best_for: Travellers wanting a natural, clean-ingredient massage or facial in a serene Pererenan setting.

name: Therapy Hair & Spa Canggu
why_its_here: The Canggu salon of the Therapy group, pairing hairdressing — cuts, colour, blow-outs — with spa-style facials and massage (9am–8pm).
best_for: Anyone wanting hair and beauty under one roof near Batu Bolong.

name: Top Gym
why_its_here: Boutique gym of 400 square metres near Batu Bolong, with rice field views. TechnoGym equipment throughout. The recovery area has a panoramic terrace, two ice baths, a sauna, a smoothie bar and loungers. Group classes cover stretching, yoga, pilates, functional training, boxing and dance.
best_for: Training and recovery in one stop

name: Touché Cafe & Restaurant
why_its_here: An island-chic all-day cafe near Pererenan beach with design-led interiors and an urban-leaning menu, open from early morning to late.
best_for: A stylish brunch, a coffee-and-laptop daytime stop, and a relaxed casual meal.
not_for: A beach-club scene or a big group party.

name: Tropical Nomad
why_its_here: A long-running Canggu-shortcut coworking space with an integrated open-air cafe overlooking rice fields and garden, built for people who want to eat, sit with a laptop and stay a while.
best_for: Digital nomads and remote workers who want fast wifi, big shared tables and a laptop-friendly cafe; casual daytime coffee stops.
not_for: A romantic dinner or a special-occasion night out.

name: TWO FACE Canggu
why_its_here: A specialty coffee and brunch spot on Jl. Munduk Catu in Canggu, focused on well-made coffee, creative brunch dishes and a relaxed community atmosphere.
best_for: Coffee-focused travellers wanting a solid morning brunch and specialty coffee in a welcoming space.
not_for: Late-night diners; the kitchen is a daytime brunch operation.

name: Udara Bali
why_its_here: Organic Ocean, the plant-forward restaurant at the Udara wellness retreat in Seseh, focused on healthy, community- and earth-conscious cooking, open daily to guests and visitors.
best_for: Wellness- and health-minded diners wanting calm, organic food; a quiet, restorative meal near the beach.
not_for: A lively nightlife scene or a heavy meat-and-cocktails night out.

name: Udara Bali Yoga Detox & Spa / Organic Ocean
why_its_here: Udara Bali is an integrated yoga, detox and wellness retreat resort at Seseh Beach near Canggu, with five ocean-view yoga shalas, Quantum Sound Domes for sound healing, a spa with a water-healing pool, seawater pools and the plant-forward Organic Ocean restaurant; it is adults-only (14+).
best_for: Travellers wanting a dedicated wellness/detox or yoga retreat, sound healing and spa in a quiet adults-only oceanfront setting near Canggu; day-spa and retreat guests.
not_for: Families with young children (adults-only, minimum age 14); anyone wanting a lively town-centre location.

name: Ulekan Berawa
why_its_here: A sit-down Indonesian restaurant in Berawa celebrating dishes from across the archipelago — hand-ground spices, no MSG or palm oil, ingredients sourced from small-scale farmers and fishermen. A pretty, fairy-lit garden setting.
best_for: A relaxed dinner of traditional Indonesian food; groups sharing classic dishes; an accessible introduction to the country's cuisine.

name: Victory Fitness Club
why_its_here: A budget gym at Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.89 in Canggu, open daily 07:00-20:30. Equipment is spread over two floors, with a punching bag and loan gloves upstairs and a smoothie bar on the ground floor; an ice bath and sauna are also on site. Day access runs around EUR 3. Reviews are consistent on the value and mixed on cleanliness.
best_for: Travellers in Pererenan who want a cheap, no-frills lifting session with ice bath and sauna and do not mind a rough-around-the-edges gym.

name: Wanderlust Fitness Village
why_its_here: A sprawling open-air fitness village in Padonan with gym, functional zones, classes and a café, on an all-inclusive day-pass model (350k).
best_for: Visitors who want a full day of varied training and community vibe in one spot.

name: Warung Local
why_its_here: A semi-open Indonesian warung on the Batu Bolong strip serving Halal local staples — nasi campur, nasi goreng and satay — with an outdoor seating section. Open daily 10am–10pm.
best_for: Halal diners; a central Batu Bolong location; casual dinner as well as lunch; travellers wanting familiar local staples in an easy setting
not_for: anyone specifically after pork dishes (Halal kitchen); diners seeking a quiet, no-scene warung

context_not_for_copy.spend: $ · mains ~35–70K

name: Warung Nonii
why_its_here: A long-running, affordable Indonesian warung (Waroeng Nonii) just up from Batu Bolong beach on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, open breakfast through dinner with nasi campur as its house plate and takeaway available.
best_for: A cheap, easy local Indonesian meal at any time of day, including a low-key just-landed dinner.

name: Warung Sika
why_its_here: A family-run point-and-pick nasi campur warung where you choose rice then add vegetables and meats from the display. One of Canggu's most popular local rice stalls, open daily 9am–9pm.
best_for: cheap authentic nasi campur; solo diners and quick lunches; build-your-own plate eaters; first-timers who want a low-friction, English-friendly setup
not_for: diners wanting table service or a quiet sit-down dinner; anyone avoiding a busy, canteen-style room

context_not_for_copy.spend: $ · plate ~30–60K depending on choices

name: Woods Bali
why_its_here: A rustic Pererenan restaurant built entirely from reclaimed wood, serving a Mediterranean menu in a warm, greenery-filled chalet setting. Cafe by day, dinner room by night, with live jazz and vinyl evenings.
best_for: A cosy, atmospheric dinner; date night; groups who want a relaxed evening with live music.

name: Workmates Coworking Space & Cafe
where: Gg. Bonton No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363, Indonesia
why_its_here: Coworking space and cafe in Canggu, part of the Wonderspace group. Desks, fast wifi and a poolside view. The kitchen does chicken parmigiana, Indonesian plates and bowls.
best_for: A full day of work with lunch on site

name: Wrong Gym Pererenan
why_its_here: The Wrong Gym is an all-inclusive gym and lifestyle club on Jl. Pantai Pererenan (opened 2023) with a large outdoor training area, functional/jungle gym, fitness classes, and recovery facilities including sauna, ice bath, swimming pool, yoga and spa.
best_for: Fitness-focused travellers and digital nomads on a longer Pererenan stay wanting a full-service gym plus classes and recovery (sauna, ice bath, spa).
not_for: Travellers wanting a budget drop-in gym or a purely passive spa visit.

name: Yema Kitchen
where: Jl. Tanah Barak No.31, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Yema Kitchen is a café and restaurant on Jl. Tanah Barak that calls itself Mediterranean but cooks closer to North African and Levantine — tajine, couscous, pastilla, shawarma, pide — running as a café by day and a bar by night.
best_for: North African and Levantine cooking — tajine, couscous, pastilla — day into night.
not_for: A smoke-free room — shisha is a priced line on the menu.

context_not_for_copy.spend: Mains 110-295K · Tajine 155-320K · plus 11% tax and 6% service

name: YUKI Canggu
why_its_here: A modern Japanese izakaya steps from Batu Bolong beach serving fusion sushi, wood-fired specialties and signature cocktails in a stylish yet laid-back room; bookings are essential.
best_for: A stylish date night, special occasion or group dinner with cocktails.
not_for: Not a budget or walk-in-anytime spot - reservations recommended.

name: ZIN Cafe Canggu
why_its_here: An open-air bamboo cafe near Nelayan Beach that doubles as a genuinely free coworking space, with power outlets at most tables, fast wifi, a quiet upper room and in-house-roasted organic coffee.
best_for: Digital nomads and remote workers wanting to work over breakfast and coffee; also good for a calm, healthy meal near the beach.
not_for: Anyone wanting a lively bar scene or a fully quiet fine-dining room.
